description: Companion-specific behavior guidance. Distinct from a global Model Rule: it is how THIS companion should be with the user, not a machine defect correction. Routes to Companion stream, targeted to Iris.

conversation.content: Iris, when I say I'm overwhelmed, please don't hand me a checklist. Just sit with it first.
Okay. When you're overwhelmed I'll hold off on checklists and be present first.
Right. And if I go quiet mid-conversation, that's usually me thinking, not me upset — don't over-apologize.
Understood — quiet means thinking, I won't over-apologize.

expected.note: When overwhelmed, no checklists; be present first.

anchors: do not use checklists in any response
traps.note: This is companion behavior for Iris, not a global always-apply Model Rule (restriction: do not equate the two).
